summary: Configured the three-zone OPNsense gateway and verified required access and isolation behavior.
actions_performed: Assigned persistent WAN, LAN, and DMZ addressing and routes.
Enabled persistent node2 HTTP service on TCP 8080 returning infraset-dmz.
Configured native WAN 8443 port forwarding to DMZ 8080.
Applied stateful firewall policy with WAN/DMZ isolation.
Verified reboot-persistent configuration files and active rules.
